name: weighted_public_geometry_task
hypothesis: C7 optimization works but imitation reduces teacher coordinate error without improving raw overlap/corridor failures. Train the same conditioned model for public geometric feasibility plus public quality, retaining teacher intent. Coefficients fixed from one pre-registered train500 local-gradient calibration; public count weighting matches official weighting emphasis.
model: Exactly C7 normalized_geometry.DeploymentModel, 1974355 trainable adapter params, frozen C1 L/F. No new NN input fields, relation heads, CPU solver strength, or inference operations.
initialization: Strictly load C7 unique own-Loss best including learned head.3 and normalization; do not reinitialize/zero. Fresh AdamW and seed0/order/scheduler; objective migration, not ordinary resume.
data: v5 frozen first16000 train and same dev_monitor500; train_monitor500 reuse train labels; source has inherited32k exposure

teacher.method: Read-only reuse completed16500 public-solver teacher, no generation
teacher.inputs: public specs/connectivity/current frozen NN draft only, no free reference geometry or official score denominators
teacher.labels: center/log-aspect of final public-solver geometry; stored only as supervision, never network input
teacher.usable: strict public hard-legal, finite, not row_control fallback; all members retained, fallback labels carry zero imitation weight
teacher.panel: train16000+dev_monitor500 only; no full dev2000 or test teacher generation

loss.teacher: Exactly C7/C1 center1+shape.25+near-relative.25, teacher usable mask retained for imitation.
loss.physics: Exact pair intersection/public area + squared minimal translation depth/mean sqrt(area), summed unordered pairs/valid N + .25 public boundary SmoothL1(beta.1) + .1 compatible public MIB log-WH MSE. Mutable unordered pairs only, all public inputs.
loss.corridor: log1p(mean squared public-anchor path deficit + .25 worst squared deficit); fixed16 native-mode0 per-axis max path relaxations. Discrete edge choices have ordinary piecewise gradients, no straight-through estimator.
loss.public_quality: .5*log1p(actual bbox/public total area)+.5*log1p(exact all-net L1 wire/(public net weight*sqrt(public area))). No reference denominator or free reference target.
loss.count_weight: Public n weighting exp((n-120)/12), normalized by fixed first16k mean0.12578465955104443. Sampler/order/batch unchanged; same weighted per-case total arithmetic mean used for backward/train500/dev500/best/LR/early-stop.
loss.calibration: candidate8_calibration_plan.json committed formula before one train_monitor500 pass, no optimizer/solver/dev/Q calls; fixed projected local-state gradient median shares physics1, corridor.5, quality.1. Weighted medians use same public count weights, positive-gradient subset only for coefficient identification; no members removed from Loss.
loss.state_gradient_caveat: Balances local-state gradient scales, not a guarantee of parameter-gradient balance or solution quality.

engine: Same batch32 FP32 CUDA graph and guarded AdamW; full original connectivity and ports pass to Loss only, network_inputs(g) filters strictly to LEGACY compressed graph. Real updates/restores and port isolation checked on original5 before start. Per-epoch original5 eval-only activation logs retained; do not drive best/LR/early-stop.
terminal: Unique own-Loss best once original dynamic-native slim3 full single-case dev500, new raw2000, same100 fourstage gallery. If best remains epoch0, verify exact C7 source model and reuse identical completed C7 terminal/raw/gallery, no repeated solve; no adapter pruning because C7 head is learned. Source C7 control reused otherwise.
caveats: Teacher imitation can misalign final Q; new public objective is still a proxy and all row fallbacks stay in full score.
Count weighting intentionally emphasizes high-N like official Q; all members and hard legality remain, no batch/split resampling.
Corridor sixteen-step fixed-shape pressure is not a global feasibility certificate; edge selection is nondifferentiable.
Full ports are Loss-only; NN compressed-port representation and deployment latency path unchanged.
Median gradient coefficient identification on exposed train500 is adaptive development; not independent generalization.
Nominal-area/teacher tolerance mismatch and9train target aspect>5 remain.
training_start_gate: Completed C7 full result/gallery/activation review, one train500 pre-registered gradient calibration complete with frozen positive finite coefficients, same5 real Adam/graph/resume/finite/frozen-C1 and strict C7 warm-start/port-isolation checks passed
control: Completed C7 unique own-Loss best dev500, same inference class/numerical solver. Stage0 exactly C7; reuse existing control, no repeat.
